description: Scrape Patreon campaigns, recent posts, search across creators, browse the Explore directory by category, or fetch a single post by URL. Pass creator vanity slugs, post URLs, search keywords, or pick an Explore category.

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If true (default), the actor automatically engages Apify Proxy when it hits HTTP 403 / anti-bot blocks from a raw datacenter IP. Set false to disable (request fails fast).
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate to Apify proxy on block

category.description: Patreon Explore topic. Leave empty to browse the top-level `/explore/` feed.
category.title: Explore category (mode=explore)

creators.title: Creator vanity slugs or URLs (mode=creator / posts)

includeCreatorDetails.description: For search and explore results, fetch each creator's full campaign page so rows include economics, tiers and social links. Off by default to keep listing runs fast and cheap.
includeCreatorDetails.title: Enrich search/explore results

includePosts.description: When `mode=creator`, also fetch the creator's recent posts.
includePosts.title: Include posts (mode=creator)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total emitted records (creators + posts combined).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPostsPerCreator.description: Hard cap on posts emitted per creator.
maxPostsPerCreator.title: Max posts per creator

minPatronCount.description: Drop creators with fewer than this many patrons.
minPatronCount.title: Min patron count

enumTitles: Campaign — creator metadata + tiers (and optionally recent posts)
Posts only — recent public posts for a creator
Search — find creators by keyword across Patreon
Explore — browse Patreon's Explore directory by category
Post by URL — fetch single post detail by post URL
mode.title: Mode

postUrls.description: Patreon post URLs to fetch individually, e.g. `https://www.patreon.com/posts/12345` or `https://www.patreon.com/posts/title-slug-12345`.
postUrls.title: Post URLs (mode=postByUrl)

proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy groups to use when auto-escalating after a block. Empty = datacenter (default), then residential fallback.
proxyGroups.title: Apify proxy groups (used on auto-escalation)

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search across all Patreon creators.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

title: Patreon Scraper Input
